Trace, implement and test: leetcode35 search insert position binary search

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <vector>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int searchInsert(vector<int>& nums, int target) {
        int L = 0, R = nums.size() - 1;
        while (L < R)
        {
            int M = (L + R) / 2;
            if (nums[M] < target)
                L = M + 1;
            else R = M;
        }
        return (nums[L] < target) ? L + 1 : L;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {1, 3, 5, 6};
    int target = 4;
    int res = sol.searchInsert(nums, target);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
